label: Bible Study
prompt: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy _____ name.
verse: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
note: David's prayer at the temple offering — the people gave so willingly that the king broke into praise.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an _____ of God through Christ.
verse: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
note: No longer a servant but a son — and sons inherit. Paul says you're an heir of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a _____ of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verse: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
note: Ezra read the law from a 'pulpit of wood' — the only time the word pulpit appears in the KJV.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much _____ enter into the kingdom of God.
verse: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
note: Paul said this soon after being stoned at Lystra and left for dead — he wasn't speaking hypothetically.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and _____ the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
verse: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
note: Jesus on discipleship: a wise builder sits down and 'counteth the cost' before laying a single stone.
